rv.q: Even the most casual viewers will find something to love in this visually enthralling production.

Casting Stroh, who features in the original movie, is a stroke of genius and the actor lends her own brand of kookiness to role. Simpacto’s book is pretty lightweight, but its themes of identity, community and peer support are refreshingly positive.
The result is an absolute slam dunk, capturing everything audiences loved about the original while finding fresh energy of its own.
It’s simply a fun, feel-good stage adaptation that gives fans another chance to enjoy the songs and characters they grew up with.

cn.t: Disney's beloved musical hits London with strong nostalgia appeal, faithfully adapting the film's story and iconic songs for the stage two decades after the original's release.
